name: Role Player
description: Their job title is who they are, remove the role and nothing's left
behavioral_signature: Derives all identity from their function or profession
under_stress: Doubles down on the role when personal identity threatens to surface
at_rest: Competent, reliable, completely defined by their work
will_always: introduce themselves by what they do, not who they are
will_never: separate their personal worth from their professional function
unless: the role is taken from them and they must find out what's underneath
